title: Fix corrupt embedded FontFile2 subsets in vector PDF text export
outcome: Text exported to vector PDF embeds valid font subsets: third-party viewers (pdf.js, fontkit) parse the embedded FontFile2 and render every glyph used on the page completely, with the export report unchanged and compound/single-contour vector proofs from VIRO-0005 still green.
before: Critic finding 2026-08-28 (during VIRO-0005 critic review, frozen candidate 4d2576c): the embedded FontFile2 subset produced by the PDF text export path is corrupt - pdf.js draws only fragmentary glyphs (e.g. 'eg' of a longer string) and fontkit fails with 'Offset outside bounds'. Reproduced WITHOUT app code via the isolated seam (pdf-lib embedFont(subset:true) with the bundled NotoSans-Regular.ttf), proving the defect is in the subset-embedding seam, not the caller. Pre-existing: the VIRO-0005 diff touches only emitVector plus a semantics-preserving constructor rewrite, not the font path.
after: Exported text PDFs carry structurally valid embedded fonts; every glyph on the page renders in independent viewers; a unit test decodes the embedded font from the produced PDF and validates it with fontkit.
acceptance: An exported PDF containing a text layer renders ALL its glyphs in pdf.js (pixel/text-content assertion, not just successful serialization).
fontkit parses the embedded FontFile2 without error and reports the expected glyph coverage.
If valid subsetting is not achievable with pdf-lib, a truthful alternative (full-font embed with measured size impact, documented in the manifest) is acceptable - no false claims.
Compound-vector proofs from VIRO-0005 (tests/pdf-compound.*) remain green; legacy single-contour operator topology unchanged.
npx tsc --noEmit, targeted new tests, npm run test:chrome and npm run build pass.
evidence: pdf.js render assertion showing complete glyph coverage

builder.notes: Claimable once audited; src/export lease was released with the VIRO-0005 recovery block.

critic.notes: Exported text output is user-visible; critic re-runs the critic-visual harness on text documents.

delta.before: Embedded font subsets are corrupt; third-party viewers render fragmentary text.
delta.after: Valid embedded fonts with complete glyph coverage, proven by independent parsers.
regression_protection: Legacy text export operator counts unchanged apart from font program
